name: Fire Emblem™ Fates
description:
From the second half of March, 2023, it will no longer be possible to purchase downloadable content.
In the digital version of the game, players must choose between and download either the Conquest path or the Birthright path after progressing to Chapter 6 in the story. The distribution of these paths will end when the sale of downloadable content on Nintendo eShop stops.
In order to play Chapter 6 and on in the game, you will need to reach that point in the story and download your path before it becomes impossible to purchase downloadable content on Nintendo eShop.

Two kingdoms are on the brink of war – and you must decide whose side to take in Fire Emblem Fates for Nintendo 3DS family systems. As a Hoshidan prince raised by Nohrian royals, you’re torn between two families. The path you choose determines the fate that awaits you and the army you lead. Command them with expert precision and form stronger relationships in this ambitious turn-based strategy game.

Join Hoshido in Fire Emblem Fates: Birthright, or fight alongside Nohr in Fire Emblem Fates: Conquest. Later on, you can explore the depth of the story in a third path, available to purchase as add-on content – Fire Emblem Fates: Revelation. After selecting your path, you can then choose to purchase the other story paths as downloadable content from Nintendo eShop.

For the first time ever, your customised avatar is the main hero. Guide your army through challenging turn-based battles, and devise your plan of attack based on your allies' classes, weapons and support levels. Each unit and weapon has strengths and weaknesses that you must balance against the foes they face. Partner your allies on the battlefield so they can support one another in combat. Building relationships is key – the closer your allies become, the better they’ll fight together.

disclaimer:
●有關遊戲軟體（下載版）及新增內容之販售服務結束
本遊戲軟體（下載版）的販售將於【2023年2月28日（二）上午8時】結束。
新增場景（未選擇的另一個場景和第3場景）及新增地圖的販售將於【2023年3月28日（二）上午8時】結束。
當場景進行到第6章時，將需要選擇「白夜王國」或「暗夜王國」任一場景，此場景為免費下載，但隨著新增場景的販售結束，今後將無法進行場景的選擇（下載）。
尚未完成場景選擇的顧客，請於【2023年3月28日（二）上午8時】前，選擇以上任一場景並預先完成下載。
此外，已購買（完成下載）的新增場景及新增地圖在販售結束後仍可再次下載。（但再次下載的服務亦預定於今後結束，敬希諒鑒。）
